prompt: Create a production pixel-art ENEMY ANT SPRITE SHEET based on the supplied game's art style reference. It is a new enemy character, not a recolor pasted over the reference. ONE transparent PNG, 4 columns by 4 rows, EXACTLY sixteen equally sized cells, no labels, text, grid lines, ground, scenery or shadows. Same enemy ant in every frame, abdomen on LEFT and head/mandibles pointing RIGHT. Match the reference's charming polished segmented ant body, slim waist, six articulated legs, bent antennae, small mandibles and tiny readable eye, with square pixel clusters and top-left light. Enemy palette: dark charcoal/indigo-violet chitin, subtle burgundy seams and cold lavender specular highlights, tiny amber eyes. Clear silhouette, the same head/abdomen/thorax size and same anatomical style as reference; not a wasp, mosquito, fly, beetle, humanoid or realistic photo. Wings: two PAIRS of long insect wings attached to thorax, pale ivory/icy blue with sparse crisp venation, represented with solid limited-palette pixels (no semitransparent halos). Row 1: FOUR SIDE VIEW FLIGHT frames, clearly different upstroke/high, midstroke/diagonal, downstroke/low, recovered/up wings; legs tucked for flying. Row 2: FOUR SIDE VIEW LANDING AND WING-SHEDDING frames: first feet reaching ground with wings raised, second grounded with wings folding backwards, third wings breaking away visibly drifting down behind body, fourth completely wingless and grounded with the detached wings disappearing outwards, not attached to the back. Row 3: FOUR SIDE VIEW WINGLESS WALK frames with alternating legs, same ant after shedding, no wings or wing stubs sticking out. Row 4: FOUR DORSAL TOP VIEW WINGLESS WALK frames, same body coloration and sizes with three legs on each side and alternating gait. Rows 1-3: keep head and abdomen aligned to same reference body region, keep body scale constant across all twelve side-view cells, foot baseline matching the reference for grounded poses. Row 4 uses centered dorsal body as reference. Wings extend into the otherwise empty area above the thorax, never outside a cell. Keep generous transparent margins between cells. At game scale, each cell will be 144x144 native pixels, the body about 108x72, so use deliberate leg and antenna clusters that survive reduction. Authentic premium hand-pixeled 2D nature-game style. Visible hard square pixel steps, limited 24-color palette, NO antialiasing, NO blur, NO gradients, NO soft outlines, NO painterly noise. Transparent background including all gaps.
processing: Prancha 4x4 recortada em 16 canvases 144x144 com amostragem nearest-neighbor; alpha >=160 convertido para 255, demais pixels para 0; paleta comum de 24 cores. Canvas fixo entre os estados; sem reenquadramento por pose. Metadados Sprite Point, sem mipmaps/compressão, 36 PPU; pivô lateral (0.5,0.25), Top (0.5,0.5).
source: Referência: quadros Ant_Walk_0..3 e Ant_Top_0..3 da colônia, repetidos e alinhados numa prancha 4x4.
